title: Listing categories
description: The platform's service categories, shared by every company.

help.title: About listing categories
help.overview: Categories are the platform's: one detailed tree of about 3,000 services that every company shares, so clients can find every provider of, say, boiler repair together. Pick the category your listing belongs to; clients post jobs in the same categories.

sections.title: Each category
items: Can't find the right one? Use Request a category. The platform reviews it; until then only your company sees it.
Leave the parent empty for a top-level section. Order sorts categories on the same level, lowest first.
Where the work happens: on site, matched by distance to a listing's service area, or online, matched anywhere.
When a client posts a job, providers with an active listing in its category, or a parent or subcategory of it, can hear about it.
To see only your sections in the listing form, pick them under Marketplace settings → What we provide.
